ox.secret.add.description: Ask the person to add or replace a named JSON secret in a native inline card: `await ox.secret.add({ purpose, key })`. The value is never a JavaScript argument or result. For model provider credentials, use ox.provider.authenticate instead.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

outputSchema.description: Key and saved or cancelled status.

ox.secret.delete.description: Ask the person to delete a secret and clear its connections: `await ox.secret.delete({ purpose, key })`.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

outputSchema.description: Key and deleted or cancelled status.

ox.secret.list.description: List secret metadata without exposing values: `await ox.secret.list({ purpose })`. Returns each secret's key, displayName, sorted JSON field names in fields, and available status.

purpose.description: Short (<10 words) description shown to the user as the step label.

outputSchema.description: Array of { key, displayName, fields: string[], available: boolean }. Fields contains only top-level JSON field names, sorted, or [] when the secret is unavailable. Never includes secret values.
